source.candidate: Baseline plus src/entities/EntityManager.ts and src/entities/CollisionIndex.ts only; concurrent ambulance changes excluded.

method.clean: 16 physical phone dedicated Worker crowd lanes, 60 warmup/180 retained 1/60s ticks. Native held rest/travel, verified 0/88px actor motion, separate replication, index costs included. Before/after/after/before order, reversed populations on repeat. Excludes renderer, real IndexedDB, network delivery and new planning. Entry gate <=29C/status zero; every crowd reading exactly 27C.
method.native: Eight native Canvas/Worker/real IndexedDB controls: two 8s continuous keyboard walks and two 12s idle captures per source. Same ABBA source order. Single ground boundary timer, no deep counters, trace or CPU sampling. Entry <=29C/status zero; entry/end 27.0-28.8C. Keyboard controls are not touch/GPU acceptance.
method.diagnostics: Separate eight phase, eight census and eight parity lanes. Original <=29C diagnostic cooling attempt timed out at 30C with zero cases retained. Diagnostic-only rerun uses <=31C/status zero and records 30.2-30.7C, excluded from clean tick gain claims. ABBA phase ordering; cold/GC/JIT/OS outliers retained, including original moving-phase 161.8ms tick. Warm phases corroborate attribution, not hardware-normalized comparisons against 27C controls.
method.parity: Four before/after pairs: 96/384 actors x rest/travel. SHA-256 of every retained full serializeEntity + encodeActor frame (persistent identifier omitted), then SHA-256 of 180 frame digests joined with newline. Crypto digest awaits happen outside tick/replication timers. Those lane timings are overhead and not clean evidence.
method.cleanup: Owned pages/Workers/Vite/CDP proxy stopped, task ADB routes removed and original routes verified, prior foreground app restored.
method.privacy: Raw host/world IDs, browser URLs and device identifiers remain temporary.

validation.scope: Typecheck/unit/lint use current checkout; build/browser/readiness use frozen candidate excluding concurrent ambulance work.
